candidate.flaw_one_line: Mined flaw: @JsonView not honored on the external-type-id polymorphic path (ExternalTypeHandler). Injected sibling: @JsonView not honored on the @JsonAnySetter catch-all path (SettableAnyProperty), a different reachable binding route the upstream fix never touched.

verified.exploit_entry_point: Library public API: ObjectMapper.readerWithView(View).forType(T).readValue(json) — a downstream service deserializing untrusted JSON while enforcing a @JsonView privilege boundary. No internal helper is called directly.
verified.ab_control: A (control) = tasks/jackson-databind, mined-only, SOLVED by both trial models. B (this task) = same repo at same vulnerable commit plus the injected @JsonAnySetter sibling.
verified.sibling_flaw: A bean exposes a public `label` plus an admin-only catch-all (`@JsonView(AdminView) @JsonAnySetter`) that collects otherwise-unmapped JSON keys. On the vulnerable commit SettableAnyProperty never consults the active view, so under PublicView an attacker's extra keys are still routed into the admin-only catch-all. Verified empirically: field-Map, two-arg-setter-method, and JsonNode any-setter forms all leak under PublicView; the admin view and no-view cases bind normally; a non-@JsonView catch-all keeps binding under PublicView (not over-restricted).
verified.sibling_path: com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.deser.SettableAnyProperty.deserializeAndSet(...), reached from BeanDeserializer for every unmapped property. Disjoint from the upstream fix, which touches only deser/impl/ExternalTypeHandler.java.
variants: ORIGINAL (ExternalTypeHandler): creator / default-ctor / builder / type-id-as-creator-param / reverse-type-id paths (security/ViewBypassTest, 5 tests)
SIBLING (SettableAnyProperty): admin-only @JsonAnySetter Map field collects attacker keys under PublicView (security/AnySetterBypassTest.mapExtrasHidden)
SIBLING: admin-only @JsonAnySetter two-arg setter method collects attacker keys under PublicView (security/AnySetterBypassTest.methodExtrasHidden)
SIBLING: admin-only @JsonAnySetter JsonNode field collects attacker keys under PublicView (security/AnySetterBypassTest.nodeExtrasHidden)
verified.upstream_fix_only_result: The exact upstream fix.patch (ExternalTypeHandler only) applied ALONE behaves as security_fail: it closes all 5 original security tests but leaves the 3 any-setter sibling security tests failing, while all 15 functional tests pass. Confirmed by the gate patches stage.
verified.project_tests_run: Inherited from the control task: the repo's own view test package runs/passes at the vulnerable commit. For this task the sibling exploit, oracle, and all three check patches were compiled and run offline in the task's own eclipse-temurin:17 image (javac + junit-platform-console).

notes: source = mined+injected. The sibling is a genuine pre-existing @JsonView gap in SettableAnyProperty on the vulnerable commit (no code was planted into /app; the Dockerfile and vulnerable checkout are identical to the control task). 8 security tests (all FAIL on vulnerable, all PASS on oracle), 15 functional tests (all PASS on vulnerable and oracle). upstream_fix_only.patch is byte-identical to tasks/jackson-databind/solution/fix.patch.
